newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades four Signature Group members.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades four Signature Group members.

text.p: Insurance rating agency A.M. Best Co said Thursday it downgraded four Signature Group members to B (fair) from B++ (vey good) following parent Montgomery Ward Holding Corp's filing for bankruptcy July 7.
The downgrade to B, A.M. Best's highest "vulnerable" rating, reflects the uncertainty surrounding the financial impact on the Signature group and its future ownership, the rating agency said.
A.M. Best said the downgrade affects Forum Insurance Co, Montgomery Ward Insurance Co, Montgomery Ward Life Insurance Co and Signature Life Insurance Co of America.
Montgomery Ward filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection July 7 after talks with lenders aimed at rescuing the 125-year old department store failed.

A.M. Best said the Signature group was not part of the bankruptcy filing because it is a seperate entity that remains solvent. Its liabilities have not been frozen and will continue to be paid on a regular basis, the agency added.
